822-5261-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-5261-7329.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-5261-7329.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

2023-3755-4770-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3534-8104.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

372-1621-2417.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-2417.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

413-1580-4871-6026.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Field of Souls and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2267-2511-3240-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-4871-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

290-1978-7170.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Living Brain.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

338-851-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-851-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

4365-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5525-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4264.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Altered Ego.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altered Ego by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4050-4533-4772-4807.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
4050-4533-4772-4807.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

38-2173-5220-6794.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

460-539-5840.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Nantuko Elder.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

11-4503-5195-5726.description:
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
When Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Three Steps Ahead, with the copy targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Three Steps Ahead, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Three Steps Ahead.
Sea Gate Stormcaller and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Three Steps Ahead.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Three Steps Ahead to your hand and creating a copy of Three Steps Ahead targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Three Steps Ahead copy, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller with haste.
When the token Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value 2 or less.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

372-3122-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Undercover Operative.
372-3122-4681.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Undercover Operative's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Undercover Operative ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Undercover Operative leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Undercover Operative from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-2060-3129-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-3129-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2557-3484-5391-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least three energy counters.
2557-3484-5391-5902.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

643-1429-3967-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-3967-5402.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4477-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
4477-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Greenwarden of Murasa and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

578-913-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-913-4222.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

662-1543-3656-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Karn Liberated has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
662-1543-3656-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Karn Liberated to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn Liberated.
Activate Karn Liberated by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1349-5239-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-5239-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Enduring Bondwarden's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden .
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 7, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

224-1772-4826-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

104-360-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
You have a way to gain life.
104-360-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat from step 2.

3020-3908-5256.description:
Cast Spark Double, choosing to have it enter as a copy of Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve its ETB trigger.
Sacrifice it to Altar of Dementia targeting an opponent.
Persist triggers, returning Spark Double with a -1/-1 counter, which is removed because of the +1/+1 counter that Spark Double enters with.
Repeat to get every creature out of each opponent library and mill them all out.
